summary: Tested backend (12 pytest tests) and frontend flows (login → schedules → batch dialog → schedule detail → add member cards → add song). 10/12 backend tests passed on first run. Found 1 CRITICAL blocker (500 on /available-volunteers when a legacy volunteer lacks 'id' field) that was fully reproduced. All feature requirements were verified after unblocking via DB data patch.

critical.issue: Returns 500 (KeyError: 'id') when the volunteers collection contains any document without an 'id' field (only Mongo _id). Legacy seed volunteer 'João Silva' triggered this. server.py lines 466 and 473 access vol['id'] without defensive check. Because ScheduleDetailPage.loadData() uses Promise.all and navigates back to /schedules on any error, THIS BLOCKS THE ENTIRE SCHEDULE DETAIL PAGE for the whole app (users cannot open any schedule, cannot use Cards Visuais, cannot manage setlist).

minor.issue: Lines 590-602 contain unreachable dead code (duplicated member_doc insert after the earlier return at line 588). Should be removed.
Persists notif_doc with current_user['id'] (line 795) but uses current_user['_id'] in create_schedule (line 369). Inconsistent - both work now but consider standardizing.

ui_bugs.issue: loadData() uses Promise.all - if the /available-volunteers 500s (see backend critical), the whole page navigates back to /schedules with generic 'Erro ao carregar dados' toast. Consider using Promise.allSettled or graceful degradation so the base schedule still renders.
Volunteer cards do not have a data-testid attribute (e.g. volunteer-card-{id}). Verified via query. Adding it aids testability.

design_issues.screen: Dialogs (Adicionar Membro, Adicionar Música, Criar Escalas em Lote)
issues: React warning: 'Missing Description or aria-describedby for DialogContent'. Add DialogDescription for accessibility.

POST /api/notifications/send: no KeyError; email_sent=false without RESEND_API_KEY ✓
GET /api/auth/me: returns both '_id' and 'id' with same value ✓
Slot limits: Vocal 6 (blocks 7th including Backing Vocal), Violão 2, Baixo 1 - all return 400 ✓
Unavailability warning: returns {warning: '...'} instead of adding member ✓
FE Login → /schedules loads, 'Criar Escalas do Mês' opens dialog with monthly calendar ✓
FE Calendar: past days gray/disabled, future days clickable, selected turn red (rgb(199,33,55) = #c72137), counter '(N selecionadas)' updates ✓

action_items: URGENT: Fix server.py get_available_volunteers_for_schedule (lines 460-482) to defensively handle volunteers without 'id' field. Simplest fix: `if 'id' not in vol: continue` at start of loop. Better: normalize legacy volunteers in a startup migration (set id = str(_id) if missing).
Also apply the same defensive check to any endpoint iterating db.volunteers (e.g., availability-related endpoints).
In ScheduleDetailPage.loadData(), switch to Promise.allSettled so the page still renders when /available-volunteers fails.
Remove dead code in server.py lines 590-602 (unreachable duplicate insert after return).
Add DialogDescription to Radix Dialogs to fix accessibility warning.
Add data-testid='volunteer-card-{id}' to volunteer cards in Add Member dialog.
critical_code_review_comments: Legacy data compatibility: /volunteers endpoint has defensive id normalization (lines 271-274) but the newer /available-volunteers endpoint does not — inconsistent pattern.
server.py 902 lines - approaching size limit; consider splitting into routers (auth, volunteers, schedules, songs, chat).
add_schedule_member has unreachable duplicated code block after the return at line 588.
current_user usage mixed between ['id'] and ['_id'] across handlers. Standardize on one (bug source risk).

success_rate.backend: 83% (10/12 pytest passed initially; both failures were the same root cause — critical bug reported above)
success_rate.frontend: 100% of verifiable flows worked after DB unblock

rca of the issue: ROOT CAUSE (critical bug): /api/schedules/{id}/available-volunteers iterates over all Ativo volunteers and accesses vol['id']. One legacy volunteer document has no 'id' field (only Mongo ObjectId in _id). REPRODUCTION: 1) Login as admin. 2) GET /api/schedules/{any_id}/available-volunteers → 500. 3) Frontend: open any schedule from /schedules list → toast 'Erro ao carregar dados' + redirect back. MITIGATION applied for testing: manually assigned uuid to the legacy volunteer. PERMANENT FIX: (a) add `if 'id' not in vol: continue` (or normalize to str(_id)) inside the loop, (b) run one-time migration to normalize existing docs, (c) also ensure /volunteers POST always writes id (already does).
